plainText:
Asami Seto (Japanese: 瀬戸麻沙美 Seto Asami) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Seto was born on April 2, 1993, in , , and became a voice actress as an adult. She first voiced Nanette, a character of the day who appeared during . She then landed a recurring role as Officer Jenny in the Alola region in the . Hirose is currently affiliated with the talent agency .
